title: Share of baby girls given the #1 most popular name, by year

source.name: Social Security Administration baby name records

notes: Linda was 5.48% of baby girls born in 1947, the single most concentrated name year in SSA's records (roughly 1 in 18 girls). Olivia, the #1 girls' name for 2024, was 0.83% of baby girls (roughly 1 in 120) -- as compiled from SSA's full national baby-name dataset by multiple demographic analyses.
